note: One primitive camping spot at a small gravel lot at the end of a gravel spur running west from Highway 95, on the edge of a mown field opening with forest around. No pads, tables or toilet. --Claude
summary: Stays under the lot rule: MDC marks one Primitive Camping point (map symbol + GIS point) at the end of a gravel spur west of Highway 95, beside a small lot. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; phone matches; pin on the point.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): page 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. No brochure. The map (11/4/2021) has a Primitive Camping legend entry and draws the symbol at the west end of an 'MDC Improved Road' spur that leaves Highway 95 at the central Parking Lot / Picnic Area. GIS layer 27: one point at 36.94393,-92.32667 = stored pin; the gravel lot (OBJECTID 8235) is 23 m east at 36.94384,-92.32644. On the leaf-off frame: a gravel spur about 250 m long ending in a gravel pad about 15 x 10 m at the corner of a mown field, the point at the pad's west end where the trees begin. No pads or loop; room for one or two rigs.
PIN: on the GIS point at the end of the spur. No move.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands - ridge-top, no water.
